query: Can I approach the labour conciliation officer directly for my wrongful termination without needing a trade union?

model_output.summary: Yes, you can approach the Labour Conciliation Officer directly for your wrongful termination without needing a trade union. Under Section 2A of the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947, the dismissal, discharge, or termination of an individual worker is deemed an industrial dispute, allowing you to file a case on your own.
facts_extracted: User wants to know if a trade union is required to approach the labour conciliation officer

options.title: Approach Conciliation Officer Directly
options.description: File an application regarding your wrongful termination directly before the Labour Conciliation Officer without requiring union sponsorship.
pros: You do not need a trade union to represent you
Provides a platform for mediated settlement
cons: Conciliation relies on voluntary agreement and may not always result in a settlement
options.forum: Office of the Labour Commissioner / Conciliation Officer

citations.relevance: Allows an individual workman to treat their termination as an industrial dispute and approach the Conciliation Officer directly without needing a trade union.
